Full-Service Accounting, Not Just Bookkeeping

Every engagement is scoped to your business, so pricing is custom — but the range of what we cover is broad by design.

  • Full Accounting

    Ongoing management of your general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, and month-end close.

  • Bookkeeping

    Accurate, up-to-date books with transactions categorized and reconciled on a regular schedule.

  • Payroll

    Accurate, on-time payroll runs, direct deposit, and remittance handling for your whole team.

  • Project Management

    Coordinated tracking of jobs, budgets, and deliverables alongside your financial data.

  • Corporate Tax Returns

    Preparation and filing of corporate tax returns, handled by professionals who know your books.

  • Business Consulting

    Strategic guidance on cash flow, growth planning, and financial decisions as your business changes.

From First Conversation to Ongoing Management

Four steps to get your books off your plate and onto ours.

  1. 01 – Book a consultation

Why Accountium's Service Is Different

We don't just recommend the software. We run our practice on it.

Most accounting firms hand you a login to a system they don't actually use day to day. Ours is different — every client we manage runs through the same Accountium platform we build and sell, so what you see is exactly what we see.

  • No black box

    Log in and see your numbers anytime — the same view your accountant has.

  • Graduate to self-serve later with zero data migration

    If you decide to take over the books yourself, your data is already in the right place. No exports, no transfers, no starting over.

  • One team, one platform, no handoffs between tools

    Your accountant, your books, and your financial dashboards all live in the same system.
